desc:
Drop into a lawless open world where every fight counts.

🔫 SHOOT – pick your pistol, win gunfights and earn cash for every kill
🚗 DRIVE – buy fast cars, paint them and take your team for a ride
🏴 CONQUER – capture zones and hold them against other players
⚔️ DUEL – challenge anyone to a 1v1 and prove you're the best
👥 TEAM UP – invite friends, ping enemies and see teammates on the map
🏆 RANK UP – climb from Bronze to Master with every kill
🎨 STAND OUT – collect gun skins, outfits, kill sounds and custom skies

Watch your back: handcuffs are real and dead players can be looted!

The green zone keeps you safe while you gear up. Once you step out, anything goes.

👍 Like the game and add it to your favorites to follow new updates!
